agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_as() valid_prev predicate. The previous logic `token.normalized != 'NULL' or not token.is_keyword` incorrectly evaluated to False when the previous token was the NULL keyword, preventing `NULL AS alias` from being grouped into an Identifier (breaking the 'null with as' behavior). Changed to `not token.is_keyword or token.normalized == 'NULL'`, which allows NULL specifically to precede AS and form an aliased Identifier (restoring 'null with as'), while still correctly rejecting other keywords (TRUE, FALSE, ASC, DISTINCT, etc.) from being merged into an aliased Identifier via AS (preserving 'dont alias keywords'). Verified manually with sqlparse.parse() on representative SQL: NULL AS foo, foo AS NULL, TRUE/FALSE/ASC/DISTINCT AS x, foo AS bar, MAX(x) AS mx, CASE...AS foo, and multi-identifier lists — all behave correctly post-fix with no other regressions observed.
